title: NOT A TOY - Gutter Kid
htmlContent:
NOT A TOY's "Gutter Kid" is a brilliant display of music that makes for an exciting listen every time you hear play. The sound is layered to perfection and gives the listener a chance to not only enjoy the sound, but explore as you are able to catch new intricacies with every listen to make it a song that will last with the people for time to come. It’s truly some of the most amazing music you will hear present day, with everything coming together to sound like a modern day musical journey worth getting lost in.

The sound is daring and pay major dividends for this genius level producer with vibes and instrumentation, that can only come from a true master of their craft.
